fields.value: Teeth Whitening in Fortitude Valley

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Over time, teeth can darken or pick up stains from coffee, tea, red wine and other everyday habits. Professional teeth whitening, provided and supervised by a dental team, can lighten the natural colour of your teeth and help reduce surface discolouration.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: At Precision Dental, we begin by making sure your teeth and gums are healthy and that whitening is suitable for you, then recommend an approach that suits your needs.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is Professional Teeth Whitening?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Professional teeth whitening uses whitening gels that are applied to the teeth under dental supervision. The gel breaks down stain molecules within the enamel and dentine, gradually lightening the tooth colour.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Depending on your needs, whitening may be performed with custom-made take-home trays, in the chair at our practice, or with a combination of both. Unlike many over-the-counter products, professional whitening is tailored to your teeth, and your dental team monitors your gums and sensitivity throughout.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Whitening works on natural teeth only. Fillings, crowns, veneers and bonding will not change colour, so we will discuss how existing restorations may look after whitening.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Is Teeth Whitening Right for You?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Whitening may be suitable for adults with:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Yellowing or darkening of teeth with age

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Surface stains from food, drinks or smoking

fields.label: List item
fields.value: An upcoming occasion where they would like a brighter smile

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Plans for veneers or crowns, where whitening first helps set the shade

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Whitening may not be suitable if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have untreated decay or gum disease, or have significant tooth sensitivity. Some types of internal discolouration, such as those caused by certain medications or trauma, may respond less predictably, and alternatives such as composite resin veneers or porcelain veneers may be discussed.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Assessment

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We start with an examination to check for decay, gum inflammation, worn enamel and existing restorations. A professional clean is often recommended beforehand so the whitening gel can make even contact with the tooth surface. We record your starting shade so you can compare progress.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Take-Home Whitening

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We take a digital scan or impressions to create trays that fit your teeth closely. You will receive your trays with professional whitening gel and clear instructions on how long to wear them each day.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: In-Chair Whitening

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For in-chair whitening, your gums and lips are carefully protected, and whitening gel is applied to your teeth for a set time under close supervision. Take-home trays may be provided to continue or maintain your results.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some temporary sensitivity is common during and shortly after whitening. A sensitive toothpaste can help. For the first 48 hours, limit strongly coloured foods and drinks. Whitening results are not permanent, and teeth may gradually darken again. Occasional top-up treatments with your trays, along with regular check-ups and cleans, can help maintain your shade.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for Teeth Whitening

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for Teeth Whitening

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Whitening tends to be most predictable when it is planned around your oral health. We check for underlying concerns first, tailor the approach to your teeth and sensitivity, and give honest guidance about what whitening can and cannot change.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Interest-free payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How long does teeth whitening last?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Results vary from person to person and depend on diet and habits such as smoking, coffee and red wine. Occasional top-ups with your custom trays can help maintain your shade.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Does whitening damage enamel?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: When used as directed under dental supervision, professional whitening is not considered to damage healthy enamel. Temporary sensitivity is the most common side effect.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Will whitening work on my crowns or fillings?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: No. Whitening only lightens natural teeth. Existing restorations stay the same colour, which may mean they need replacing to match your new shade.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How white will my teeth become?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Every person responds differently. The final shade depends on your natural tooth colour, the type of staining and how consistently you follow the whitening plan.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Is professional whitening better than supermarket kits?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Professional whitening is tailored to your teeth, uses custom-fitted trays and is supervised by your dental team, who check that whitening is suitable for you and monitor sensitivity and gum health.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I whiten my teeth if they are sensitive?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Possibly. We can adjust the approach, recommend a desensitising toothpaste and monitor your comfort. In some cases, we may advise against whitening.
